about.lead: I'm a Computer Science student at Marietta College and a national-level rower for Paraguay. I like building systems that mix data, algorithms and a good user experience.
points: Applied AI and data: forecasting, dashboards and AI agents that save teams time.
Full-stack projects from database to interface, built to be simple to use.
Elite-sport discipline: teamwork, endurance and leadership under pressure.

bullets: Member of the Performance & Data Analytics team, working with business areas across Grupo Vázquez companies.
Helped build a Python forecasting pipeline that predicts daily volume for 9 ueno bank transaction products, flags unusual days and projects the month-end close.
Added a Paraguayan holiday module so forecasts anticipate pre- and post-holiday spikes and drops, with the reason for each adjustment exported for management.
Helped build a live executive dashboard for credit card transactions and active customers.
Co-designed the Orquestador, an internal multi-agent AI tool that turns plain-language questions into SQL, analysis and reports.
Cared for plants, animals and tools in the lab.
Implemented and worked on an automatic watering system for 3 months.
Prepared special orders, handled money and customer communication.
Planned and navigated delivery routes efficiently.
Cashier, stock control, store opening and closing.

projects.title: Orquestador
projects.text: An internal multi-agent AI tool, co-designed with my team and built with Cursor. It turns plain-language questions into SQL, analysis and reports. The visual here is an illustration, not company data.

projects.title: Transaction forecasting
projects.text: A Python pipeline that predicts expected daily volume for 9 ueno bank products, flags unusual days, projects the month-end close and adjusts for Paraguayan holidays.

projects.title: Executive dashboard
projects.text: A live dashboard tracking credit card transactions and active customers, with weekly and monthly trends measured using robust statistics. Illustration only.

projects.title: Catch Analysis
projects.text: A rowing training log that imports ergometer data and turns it into goals and tips to improve. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Supabase, hosted on Vercel.

projects.title: Erg pace calculator
projects.text: A small web tool for ergometer pacing: set a goal and get the splits you need to hold.

projects.title: Web programming projects
projects.text: Full-stack sites built in class with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and SQL: user input, sessions, server-side processing and database storage.

projects.title: Database design
projects.text: Relational schemas normalized from 1NF to BCNF, with primary and foreign keys and complex queries using joins and subqueries.

projects.title: Pep9 operating systems
projects.text: Assembly-level work in the Pep9 machine for Computer Organization and Operating Systems classes.

rowing.lead: Rowing is the thread through my whole life: varsity at Marietta College and international regattas for Paraguay.
medals: Silver, South American Rowing Championships, Asunción 2021
Silver and Bronze, Coastal Rowing Cup, Lima 2022

learning.lead: I want to understand how AI models learn from data, how decisions are made, and how to measure and improve them.
points: AI and data in sport: models over ergometer metrics and training loads to give personal feedback, pacing strategies and smarter training.
Applied AI that serves communities: understandable, accessible, useful tools.
After ITTI, I want to keep building tools that make a whole team's work easier.
